Shown with a worked example that recalculates as it changes: Egypt, VAT 14%, a ticket listed at EGP 100.00 with 20% off is paid at EGP 80.00; after discount the VAT is EGP 11.20 (guest pays EGP 91.20), before discount it is EGP 14.00 (guest pays EGP 94.00). The setting shows the Egypt worked example. **Tax documents** (CHG-FIN-011): the template sets the title the law prescribes, the auto-issue of the simplified tax invoice (on for a UAE registrant), and the AED 10,000 limit above which a VAT-registered buyer gets a full tax invoice.
